original_prompt: Create Christmas Themed Marketing Banner for a new Carnival Saga event in the game.
prompt: Wide cinematic banner backdrop, mobile game illustration style. Right two-thirds: festive carnival scene with chibi characters in Santa hats and colorful carnival costumes, celebrating joyfully under golden volumetric light rays. Giant decorated Christmas tree wrapped in carnival ribbons, confetti streamers, and glowing ornaments bursts upward as focal point. Characters have large expressive eyes, oversized heads, vibrant deep indigo, amber gold, emerald green, hot pink, and sky blue outfits with glossy highlights. Floating snowflakes mix with golden sparkle particles and bokeh light orbs. Warm rim lighting with cool purple-blue atmospheric depth. Left third reserved as text-safe zone: deep navy-to-teal soft gradient, minimal detail, subtle bokeh only, muted and clean for text overlay. Hand-painted soft shading, no hard outlines, forms defined by color contrast. Brazilian carnival energy fused with Christmas warmth. Rich saturated festive palette, dramatic golden-hour lighting, subtle depth-of-field.
